turns.question: At which hour of the day did the most checkout events happen between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many were there in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hour-of-day grain, so it cannot say which hour had the most checkout events between 20 September and 3 October 2026 or how many there were. The closest metrics are Checkout sessions and Customer actions (filtered to the checkout action type), which count by day only; no query was run, so there is no freshness statement for this answer.
